subject: Copywriting
title: The Video Sales Letter
description: One-minute skill: The Video Sales Letter.

hook.text: Video sales letters convert 80% better than text-only pages for some products. The camera does what words alone cannot.

buildup.text: Jon Benson pioneered the VSL format: a narrated slide presentation that follows the classic sales letter structure.

discovery.text: VSLs work because they control the pace. Unlike text, where readers skip ahead, video forces sequential consumption.

twist.text: Many VSLs hide the buy button until the pitch is complete. Controversial, but the data shows it increases conversions.

climax.text: The VSL proved that the sales letter principle is medium-agnostic. The format adapts; the psychology stays constant.

punchline.text: Video, text, or audio. The sales letter adapts to any format.

quiz.question: Why do video sales letters sometimes hide the buy button?
options: It forces viewers to watch the full pitch, increasing conversions
